name: Support plan upgrade policy example
answer:
Customers can upgrade plans immediately from the billing page.
Customers can upgrade plans only at the next renewal.
Plan upgrades automatically refund the unused portion of the current term.

sources.title: Support Plan Upgrade Policy
sources.content:
Customers can upgrade plans immediately from the billing page.
The new plan takes effect immediately and the customer is charged a prorated amount for the remainder of the billing period.
